faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I book a transfer?
faq.a1: You can contact us in any convenient way: by phone, via whatsapp, via email, or through the form on our website.
faq.a2: Yes, free cancellation up to 24 hours before pick-up.
faq.q3: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.a3: We track your flight and adjust the pick-up time at no extra cost.
faq.q4: Does the driver assist with luggage?
faq.a4: Yes, the driver will certainly assist you with your luggage.
faq.q5: Can I order a child car seat?
faq.a5: Yes, if you are traveling with a child, this can be arranged during the booking stage.
faq.q6: How much does the trip cost?
faq.a6: The price depends on the route and vehicle class. Leave a request or message us — we will quickly provide you with a personalized quote.
